tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /grub chen lwa ba pa'i gdams pa skal ldan cig char ba'i tshul

du ngo sprod pa'i thabs snyan rgyud lhan cig skyes pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ 'dir slob dpon lwa ba pa'i gdams pa/ skal ldan cig char ba'i tshul du ngo sprod pa'i thabs/ snyan rgyud lhan cig skyes pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba 'di la/ sems ma bcos pa lam du byed pa dang*/ rnam rtog ma bcos pa lam du byed pa dang*/ snying rje chen pos lha bskul ba dang*/ bla ma bskul ba ste bzhi las/ dang po ni spro na skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams spyi dang mthun par bya/ mi spro na ma byas kyang rung*/ lus gnad rnam snang gi chos bdun spyi dang mthun par bcas la/ rang sems la rang gis cher gyi gtad nas 'jog pa las/ rnam dag gi rtsol ba ye mi byed pa nyid nyams len gyi mthil dang*/ de'i ngang nas rtog pa gang shar gyi rang ngo la bltas pas/ rnam rtog nyid dbyings su dag pa'i rig gsal tsam la mnyam par bzhag /gal te ngo mi shes su cung zad 'jam na/ rig pa drag tu bcun la de ltar mi 'gro ba'i zhe bcad dam po dang rnam pa thams cad du sgrim pa gal che/ gnyis pa ni/ des bcom med du sems gnas na/ rnam rtog gang shar 'char sgo lam me ba ma 'gags pa de la/ khong nas dran 'dun gyis zin par byas te ched gtad bkag kyang mi bkag /bcas bcos kyang mi byed/ dran pas zin phyin chad 'gyur na'ang gyur tu bcug /gnas na'ang gnas su 'jug pa yin/ de'i sngar gyi dran 'dzin zhan du song na/ dmigs pa snga ma la brtan pa ma thob pa yin pas/ skabs der rnam rtog rgya 'jam du 'gro ba'i skyon yongs pas/ dmigs pa snga ma la re shig 'bad/ dran 'dzin ngan du ma song na/ gang shar ngos 'dzin pa de kho na la 'bad cing*/ skabs re sgrims skabs re glod pa spel mas nyin mtshan thams cad 'da' bar bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rang yi dam gang mos su gsal zhing rtsa dbu ma spyi bo nas lte ba'i bar du yod pa/

lte bar a dmar po/ rlung ro man gsum phyir gsal/ oṃ kyi gdangs kyis rlung nang du drangs/ steng 'og gi rlung kha sbyar/ a'i gzugs dang*/ a'i gdangs la sems gtad/ mi bde ba med tsam du bzung nas dal bus 'bud pa na/ hūm̐ gi gdangs kyis 'bud par bsam ste/ yi ge gsum gyi rdor bzlas bum can no/ /yi ge gnyis kyi rdor bzlas ni/ gzhan rnams sngar dang 'dra ba la/ lte bar thig le dmar po/ rlung dal bus rgyun mi chad par nang du rngubs pa na/ ho'i gdangs kyi 'jug par bsam/ rngubs pa rdzogs pa dang*/ dal bus hūṃ gi gdangs kyis phyir 'bud par bsam/ 'di la cher 'dzin pa mi dgos so/ /bzhi pa ni rang gi spyi bor bla ma rdo rje 'chang rang dang 'dra ba'i yum can zhig gsal btab ste/ mos gus dung bas/ bdag gi bde ba dang sdug bsngal khyod kyis mkhyen no/ /bde yang rung sdug bsngal yang rung khyed las gzhan na ma mchis so/ /ci mang gsol ba btab pas/ spyi bo nas snying khar byon/ rang sems dang dbyer med yin snyam du mos la sngar bzhin gsol ba btab/ mthar gang yang mi bsam/ mdun gyi bar snang la har te lta ba dang*/ sngar lta bu'i spros bral gyi ngang bskyong ngo*/ /de ltar na dmigs pa dang po nyams len gyi mthil yin la/ gzhan gsum bogs 'don yin cing*/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rang sems la khong nas 'char ba yin no// sems ma bcos pa dang rnam rtog lam du byed pa rdo rje'i tshig dang pos bstan/ bde ba'i sgom tshul gnyis las bstan/ lha dang bla ma bskul ba nyid gsum pas bstan/ de la brten nas ye shes 'chad tshul bzhi pas bstan pa yin no/ /zhes pa 'di yang rdo rje slob ma lhun grub bzang pos bskul ba'i ngor tā ra nā thas smras so/ /bkra shis so// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/grub chen lwa ba pa'i gdams pa cig char ba'i ngo sprod snyan rgyud lhan cig skyes pa'i rnal 'byor bzhugs/
